{{Quote|Agent Rayar here. Dock with me when you're ready. I'll need to get that information to our intelligence agency soon.|Rayar|<ref name="SWG:SfBS" />}}
'''Rayar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] and member of the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] intelligence ring during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]] between Car'das and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] forces, Laetin A'shera's pilots eliminated a Black Sun spy during a patrol mission in the [[Lucent Ivaya]] quadrant of the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. Information found on the spy was quickly transmitted to Agent Rayar.<ref name="SWG:SfBS" />
